Explanatory Statement on Repurchase of Our Own Securities
The following paragraphs include, among others, certain information required by the Stock
Exchange to be included in this Prospectus concerning the repurchase of our own securities.
(a). Reasons for repurchase
The Board considered that the repurchase of the H Shares would be beneficial to and in the
best interests of the Company and its Shareholders as a whole. It can strengthen the investors’
confidence in the Company and promote a positive effect on maintaining the Company’s reputation
in the capital market. Such repurchases will only be made when the Board believes that such
repurchases will benefit the Company and its Shareholder as a whole.
(b). Exercise of the general mandate to repurchase Shares
Subject to the passing of the special resolution approving the grant of the general mandate to
repurchase Shares at annual general meetings, the Board will be granted the general mandate to
repurchase Shares until the end of the relevant period. The general mandate to repurchase Shares
would expire on the earlier of:
(i) the conclusion of the next annual general meeting of the Company of which time it shall
lapse unless, by special resolutions passed at that meeting, the authority is renewed,
either conditionally or subject to conditions;
(ii) the revocation or variation of the mandate under the resolution by a special resolution
at the next general meeting of the Company; or
(iii) the revocation or variation of the mandate under the resolution by a special resolution
at any general meeting of the Company.
Furthermore, we need to complete registration and approval procedures with relevant
government authorities for the actual grant of the repurchase mandate to the Board, as applicable.
The exercise in full of the general mandate to repurchase H Shares (on the basis of 147,869,769
Shares in issue as of the Listing Date and no H Shares will be allotted and issued or repurchased
by the Company on or prior to the date of the next annual general meeting) would result in a
maximum of 14,786,976 H Shares being repurchased by the Company during the relevant period,
being the maximum of 10% of the total H Shares in issue immediately following the completion of
the Global Offering (excluding (i) the additional Shares which may be issued pursuant to the
exercise of the Over-allotment Option).
(c). Source of funds
In repurchasing its H Shares, the Company intends to apply funds from the Company’s
internal resources (which may include surplus funds and retained profits) legally available for such
purpose in accordance with the Articles of Association and the applicable laws, rules and
regulations of the PRC.
TheCompanyisempoweredbyitsArticlesofAssociationtorepurchaseitsShares.Anyshares
to be repurchased will be cancelled or transferred if allowed by the Articles of Association and
applicable laws and regulations.Any repurchases by the Company may only be made out of either
the funds of the Company that would otherwise be available for dividend or distribution or out of
the proceeds of a new issue of shares made for such purpose. The Company may not purchase
securities on the Stock Exchange for a consideration other than cash or for settlement otherwise
than in accordance with the trading rules of the Stock Exchange from time to time.

(d). Suspension of repurchase

board meeting (as such date is first notified to the Stock Exchange in accordance with the Listing
Rules) for the approval of the company’s results for any year, half-year, quarterly or any other

interim period (whether or not required under the Listing Rules), until the date of the results

exceptional circumstances.

We have applied to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange for a waiver from strict compliance with
the disclosure requirements under Rule 17.02(1)(b) of the Listing Rules. For more details, see
“Waivers — Waiver in relation to the Pre-IPO Equity Incentive Plan”.
ThefollowingisasummaryoftheprincipaltermsofthePre-IPOEquityIncentivePlan,which
was adopted by the Company in January 2019 and amended in October 2024 and June 2025. The
Pre-IPO Equity Incentive Plan is not subject to Chapter 17 of the Listing Rules as it does not
involve any further grant of awards by the Company after the Listing.
1. Purposes
The Pre-IPO Equity Incentive Plan seeks to enhance corporate governance, attract and
retain exceptional talent, and empower entrepreneurial-minded employees through a shared
innovationplatform,aligningshareholder,corporate,andstaffinterestsbyenablinglong-term
contributors to benefit from company growth.
2. Eligible Participants
TheCompanyshalldeterminetheeligibleparticipantsinaccordancewiththeapplicable
laws and the relevant provisions of theArticles ofAssociation and in light of the Company’s
actual situation.
Eligible participants shall be employees with labor relationships and employment
contracts with the Company (including branch companies/subsidiaries).
3. Administration
The Board of Directors is responsible for formulating and amending the Pre-IPO Equity
Incentive Plan.
A management committee (the “Management Committee”) is established under the
Pre-IPO Equity Incentive Plan and shall be responsible for the day-to-day administration of
the plan, including but not limited to managing the list of eligible participants and handling
the registration of Share Awards.
4. Source of Shares
ThesourceoftheunderlyingSharesofPre-IPOEquityIncentivePlanshallbetheequity
interests in our Company which correspond to RMB10,000,000 of the Company’s registered
capital.
5. Total Number of Shares
Under the Pre-IPO Equity Incentive Plan, the total number of ShareAwards represented
an aggregate of 10,000,000 Shares, representing approximately 6.76% of the total number of
Shares in issue immediately after completion of the Global Offering (assuming the
Over-allotment Option is not exercised).

6. Term
There is no expiry date for the Pre-IPO Equity Incentive Plan.
7. Vesting Period, Holding Period and Service Period
ThevestingperiodfortheShareAwardsunderthePre-IPOEquityIncentivePlanisfour
years and set out below:
(a) 25% of the aggregate number of Share Awards to be vested following the 12th
month after the relevant Share Awards having been registered under the relevant
Grantee(s) as recorded in the Share Award agreement (the “Grant Date”);
(b) 25% of the aggregate number of Share Awards to be vested following the 24th
month after the Grant Date;
(c) 25% of the aggregate number of Share Awards to be vested following the 36th
month after the Grant Date; and
(d) the remaining 25% of the aggregate number of Share Awards to be vested
following the 48th month after the Grant Date.
Duringthevestingperiod,ifaneligibleparticipantfailstocontinuouslymeetthevesting
conditions specified in the Pre-IPO Equity Incentive Plan, the Share Awards cannot become
vested.Iftherecipientmeetsthevestingconditionsbutfailstomaketherequiredpaymentfor
the granted Share Awards on time and in full, the corresponding Share Awards held by the
recipient will not be vested.
UndertheShareAwardsunderthePre-IPOEquityIncentivePlan,aneligibleparticipant
may not sell, transfer, or otherwise dispose of their granted Share Awards in any manner
starting from the date when the recipient’s granted Shares Awards are fully vested and ends
on the date when the company completes its listing on a stock exchange. Throughout the
holdingperiod,theShareAwardsheldbytherecipientsmustnotbeusedascollateral,torepay
debts, or to establish any other rights over the shares.
Under the ShareAwards under the Pre-IPO Equity Incentive Plan, the service period for
alleligibleparticipantsisfouryears,startingfromtheGrantDate.Aneligibleparticipantmust
work continuously for the Company for four years without any performance requirements
before the Share Awards can be fully vested in accordance with the schedule above. If an
incentive recipient is granted multiple times, their service period will be calculated separately
for each Grant Date in batches.
8. Transfer and Repurchase of Share Awards
During the lock-up period, the eligible participants shall not sell, transfer or dispose of
their Share Awards in any way; upon the expiration of the lock-up period, the eligible
participants may transfer their ShareAwards to the other eligible participants as approved by
the Management Committee or request that their Share Awards be repurchased by a
Repurchase Right Holder (as defined below) as approved by the Management Committee.
Without the written approval of the Management Committee, any sale, transfer or disposal of
the Share Awards by the eligible participants shall be invalid.
If an eligible participant commits any serious offences or is otherwise in breach of any
applicable laws and regulations as specified in the Pre-IPO Equity Incentive Plan when
leaving the Company, regardless of whether the ShareAwards held by the eligible participant
have been fully or partially unlocked, and regardless of whether the Company’s Shares are
